text: The doctor provided excellent care. Everything was clear and easy to understand. They gave great advice on everything. They sent videos and photos updating my child's condition daily, which helped alleviate my worry.
The vet is very kind. She speaks politely, explains things clearly, and it's easy to understand. I've brought my 7 cats here for treatment all the time. She also offers overnight boarding services.

The doctor and assistants were incredibly kind. The treatment was excellent, their kindness and service were great, and they provided wonderful advice and consultation. I was very impressed. Thank you so much to the doctor and the assistants! // I brought my stray cat in for treatment, and we hadn't named him yet, so the doctor helped give him a nickname. The doctor and assistants were incredibly kind and helpful, as I said. Thank you on behalf of Chaokui too! 🐈‍⬛
The doctor is lovely, skilled, and very kind. The service is excellent, and it's great value for money at a reasonable price. I highly recommend her!

There are many vet clinics in the Mae Rim area, but we have had great service here.  Our small dog was hit by a car one evening and had a serious head injury.  We raced to AppleTree as it was closest if not the largest for trauma cases and we knew they would be open early evening.  The vet stayed up for the next 24 hours monitoring our dog and ended up saving his eye.  He has now recovered, and she still refers to him as ‘my son’.  The vet here has an absolute love for animals.  Her English skills are good enough for basic conversation with foreigners who do not have enough Thai skills to speak about pet health issues.  Great place and really recommended, especially for small breeds.
Dr. Kai is very friendly, kind, and takes excellent care of the children. The clinic is very clean. If you need treatment, sterilization, or childbirth services, I highly recommend this place.

My dog was sent to clinic and admitted there later for Pyometra. I was so nerved that time and lots of questions to ask. Doctor promised she will try her best to save my dog however there's some risk as per condition of sickness and should see case by case and cannot guarantee 100% but will try the best. I don't have much option only find best way to treat my dog fast. I agreed and told me told her whatever you have to save my dog. She said I cannot explain now and first priority has to save my dog first then she immediately ran into operating room. I was so hectic, curious and waiting there almost 5 hrs. Finally doctor came out from operating room to told me that "your dog are safe with us" but have to stay in clinic for closely observation. I was so happy to hear such a great news that she is safe. Doctor explain to me slowly as her English speaking is not so good after I calmed. this is not most important thing but service mind and how doctor LOVES pets likes family member this shows the most important which no one want to lost your beloved ones.

My dog were stay there 3 days and health condition was improved very fast which I was unexpected. What I have seen doctor very keen on pets and my dog really get along well with her and likes to play with her. For sure I will take my dog to visit doctor again for some occasion.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank you to doctor for saving my love puppy.

Again thank you so much
Taking my dog ​​to get spayed was a great experience. The vet explained everything very well. My dog ​​recovered well and the wound healed normally.
The doctor is very kind. I come here regularly. 😊😊😊 …
